GitLab and Gitea/Forgejo, plus `--open`. This is the v0.3 milestone from the [roadmap](https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/blob/v0.3.0/ROADMAP.md): the same one command now answers "why is this line like this?" on GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg and self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo, and reads which forge it is from your remote.

```console
$ linelore internal/commands/packages/download/download.go:290      # gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli
  commit  28cd7b06fe  2026-10-16  José M. Requena Plens
          fix(packages): verify the checksum of the newest file with the same name
  MR !4112  fix(packages): verify the checksum of the newest file with the same name  (@jmrp, merged 2026-10-16)
          https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/merge_requests/4112
  fixes #8615  glab packages download checks a re-uploaded file against the checksum of its first upload [closed]

$ linelore grid.c:930                                                 # codeberg.org/dnkl/foot
  commit  d4896e386b  2026-09-08  Celina Sophie Kalus
          grid: reflow: Preserve cells with background color
  PR #2463  grid: reflow: Preserve cells with background color  (@celinakalus, merged 2026-09-10)
          https://codeberg.org/dnkl/foot/pulls/2463
  fixes #2462  Colored, cleared cells are deleted when resizing the window [closed]
```

(Real output from v0.3.0, trimmed to the key lines.)

## Added
- **GitLab** (gitlab.com and self-managed): commit → merge requests → the issues each MR closes → diff notes from the MR discussions, replies included. MRs show as `MR !123`; subgroups (`group/sub/project`) work. Token: `GITLAB_TOKEN`. gitlab.com only shows discussions to signed-in users, so without a token the review comments are skipped with a note and everything else still shows.
- **Gitea and Forgejo** (Codeberg, gitea.com, code.forgejo.org, self-hosted): commit → PR → `Fixes`/`Closes`/`Resolves` references looked up as real issues → review comments. Token: `GITEA_TOKEN` or `FORGEJO_TOKEN`. Gitea only links a PR to its merge commit, so when a line came in through a merge commit linelore finds that merge locally and asks again. It never pins a direct push on a later merge.
- **Forge detection** from the remote URL: known hosts, host names containing `gitlab` / `gitea` / `forgejo` / `github`, and `~/.ssh/config` aliases like `github-work`. Override with `--forge {github,gitlab,gitea,forgejo}`. For self-hosted, `--api URL` (`/api/v4` implies GitLab, `/api/v1` Gitea). An unknown host gets a note naming the flag to pass; linelore doesn't send a request to an API it guessed.
- **`--open`** opens the PR/MR in your browser after printing the lore. For a range it opens the most recently merged one; with no PR, or with `--offline`, it opens the commit page. On a machine with no desktop it prints the URL on stderr and doesn't start a console browser, so `--json --open` keeps stdout clean.
- **`forge` in `--json`** (`"github"`, `"gitlab"`, `"gitea"`, or `null`). Everything else keeps the same shape on every forge.

## Improved
- **Errors you can act on.** Rate limits, 401s, missing repos and unpushed commits say which host it was and which token variable to set. An `--api` URL that returns HTML is called out. The timeout is now 30 s (`LINELORE_TIMEOUT`) because Codeberg can be slow on a cold request. An unpushed commit is a note, not a failure.
- **Terminal output.** Open PRs say "still open" and closed-unmerged ones say "closed without merging" (they used to say "merged ?"). URLs are dimmed. Long PR bodies and review comments wrap to the terminal width, and stay on one line when piped. Excerpts drop template headings, markdown link targets and `Signed-off-by` trailers. In a range, a PR shared by several commits is printed once.
- **GitHub Enterprise.** GraphQL now goes to `/api/graphql`; it used to go to `/api/v3/graphql`, which doesn't exist. The token comes from `gh auth token --hostname HOST`. Promoted issue links point at your host instead of github.com.
- Tokens only go to the forge they belong to. Cache keys include the forge. `Fixes https://…/issues/N` and nested `group/sub/project#N` refs are recognised.

## Install
```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore@v0.3.0
# or
pip install https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/releases/download/v0.3.0/linelore-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Python 3.9+, no dependencies. Docs: [Forges](https://blackman99.github.io/linelore/docs/forges/). Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)
